args.title: Ironbark Tooling – Freight Pricing This Quarter (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
• Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices (rather than a fixed schedule).
• Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Source: Ironbark Tooling newsletter → article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight) + companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion).
